headline: Committee reviews lawsuit settlement, goes into closed-door session

meeting.body: Maui County Council Government Relations, Ethics, and Transparency Committee
meeting.summary: The committee reviewed Resolution 26-141 to settle a federal retirement-contribution lawsuit and voted 8–0 to go into executive session.
meeting.recap: The committee took up Resolution 26-141, which would let the Department of the Corporation Counsel (the County's lawyers) settle a federal lawsuit.[[0:08:28]] The lawsuit claims the County failed to make required retirement contributions after the plaintiff's military service with the U.S. Air Force.[[0:08:39]] A deputy corporation counsel said the plaintiff was employed by the Maui Police Department.[[0:09:58]] He said the County received a confidential settlement demand from the plaintiff's side.[[0:10:42]] He said he submitted the resolution on August 14th.[[0:11:07]] A deputy corporation counsel said that after the lawsuit, the County learned the plaintiff had cashed out his ERS retirement account.[[0:19:56]] A County official said workers who do not plan to reach 10 years can withdraw the contributions they made.[[0:22:29]] A deputy corporation counsel said the plaintiff spent four years in the military.[[0:24:26]] He confirmed the alleged missing contributions cover four years.[[0:25:19]] The committee voted 8–0 to go into executive session (a closed-door discussion) to consult with its lawyers.[[0:26:04]] Staff said the vice chair could be moved into the closed session once she logs on.[[0:29:55]]
meeting.next: The committee will reconvene in executive meeting after a five-minute recess. The vice chair said she would join the closed session once she is home and alone.
